2026_004_11_may_2026_check_register.paragraph: Troy School District's check register by fund for fiscal year 2026 accounting period 11, produced by Pentamation Enterprises, Inc. as report ACCTPA21 on 07/09/2026 and carried in the Board of Education packet for the meeting of July 22, 2026. The listing runs to page 37 and covers checks numbered 2603275 through 2603686 issued 05/07/26 and 05/21/26, together with wire items W26-230 and W26-241 through W26-266, distributed across twelve funds. The TOTAL REPORT is $8,629,110.44, of which the 2023 Building and Site fund accounts for $3,814,578.98 and the General Fund for $2,913,423.08.
2026_004_11_may_2026_check_register.page:
**Report identification**
Pentamation Enterprises, Inc. report ACCTPA21, CHECK REGISTER - BY FUND, run for Troy School District on 07/09/2026 at 10:43:44. Selection criteria: transact.yr='26' and transact.period='11'; accounting period 1/27. Included in the Board of Education agenda material for the July 22, 2026 meeting. The register extends to page 37 and posts against cash accounts A1003 and A1013.

**Scope**
Regular checks run from 2603275 to 2603686, issued 05/07/26 and 05/21/26. Electronic/wire items are numbered W26-230, W26-241 through W26-251, W26-256 through W26-261, and W26-266, with issue dates from 05/01/26 to 06/01/26. Three prior-period checks appear flagged V (voided): 2601773 dated 12/18/25 to Oakland County Health at -858.35, 2602931 dated 03/26/26 to MI Water Polo Association at -500.00, and 2603257 dated 04/23/26 to Richard Parks at -2,160.00.

**Largest single payments**
Barton Malow Enterprises wire W26-248 dated 05/20/26 totals 3,427,111.15 against Fund 423, with construction draws including Smith at 1,855,829.44 and 118,950.54, technology at 671,761.27, AHS at 421,142.83, administration at 282,257.10 and 42,958.44, THS at 122,823.26, tech equipment at 74,640.13, Costello at 20,805.85, Wattles at 11,246.60, Schroeder at 9,476.79, Leonard at 8,743.97, Wass at 7,517.50, and a Hamilton credit of -221,042.57. MI Educ Spec Serv Assoc wire W26-256 dated 05/19/26 pays a June premium totaling 1,467,325.75, built from lines of 1,468,415.87, -1,447.24, 178.56 and 178.56. Compass Group USA Inc wire W26-251 dated 05/14/26, drawn on cash account A1013, totals 669,430.68 for food purchases of 231,778.28 and non-food purchases of 437,652.40. EduStaff LLC wire W26-266 dated 05/08/26 charges contracted services of 258,424.96 to Fund 101, 231,563.44 to Fund 122, 41,697.24 to Fund 531, 23,125.30 to Fund 530 and 4,983.59 to Fund 120.

**Transportation and utilities**
First Group America check 2603318 totals 228,345.55 in the General Fund, including general education routes at 186,522.24 and mid-days at 23,342.34, and 221,731.28 in Special Education, including special education routes at 199,259.34 and monitors at 21,751.88. Direct Energy Marketing bills 68,525.50 on check 2603484 (THS 21,166.68, AHS 18,935.01) and 19,343.55 on check 2603311. R K A Petroleum check 2603618 totals 64,377.51 for diesel and DEF.

**Instructional, technology and facilities**
Renaissance Learning check 2603395 totals 110,080.00 for eduCLIMBER implementation; Frontline Technologies check 2603507 is 94,876.50 for a 26/27 bundle; Power Techniques Inc check 2603611 totals 132,875.06 for UPS equipment; Troy Robotics Foundation check 2603671 is 51,063.28 under an MDE 99th competitive grant; Clean-Ed LLC wire W26-230 totals 42,519.50 for contracted cleaning.

**Student activity and scholarships**
Student Activity Fund items include a 65,000.00 payment to New Day Foundation for AHS Charity Week, 24,548.66 to Golf Facilities Inc for AHS prom, 22,316.00 to National Trails LLC, 14,960.00 to MI HOSA, and 14,422.00 to YMCA of Greater Flint for Bemis fifth-grade camp. The Memorial Scholarship Fund pays 67,000.00 in named awards, including Bayer and Guha scholarships of 10,000.00 each.
